title: Museum Tiroler Bauernhoefe Kramsach
highlights: Groesstes Freilichtmuseum Tirols mit 14 originalen historischen Bauernhoefen
Authentisch eingerichtete Hoefe und Nebengebaeude aus verschiedenen Tiroler Taelern
Historische Saegemuehle, Schmiede, Muehle und traditionelle Bauerngaerten

kurzbeschreibung: The open-air Museum Tiroler Bauernhöfe in Kramsach invites visitors on an atmospheric journey back in time through 14 historic Tyrolean farmhouses.
beschreibung:
Traditional Farming Culture in the Open-Air Museum

Nestled in an idyllic hilly landscape near the Kramsacher Seen lies the Museum Tiroler Bauernhöfe. Across the expansive grounds, 14 original farmhouses from all parts of Tyrol were dismantled with great care and faithfully reconstructed.

A Vibrant Village of Past Centuries

From the mighty Unterinntaler Hof to the austere mountain farm from the Ötztal, the farmsteads bear witness to the arduous daily life and master craftsmanship of earlier generations. Historic sawmills, functioning water mills, and fragrant herb gardens make the walk a delightful experience for the entire family.
